column2: Buran-19, this is Baikonur... no. Nobody answers. Station debris all around. Two transponders still beep nearby: Sasha, Lena. Fly close, the beam will take them.
The hull is holding. To get home we need metal and rock. The laser is charged: point the nose at an asteroid, it burns, then pull the fragments in.
Something hums out there and the radar flickers. Three more of ours are drifting in this sector. If the discharge comes for you, let it close and hit the EMP.
